title: MBTA Transit Equity & Civic Improvement Dashboard
description: A multilingual, AI-powered civic tool that exposes transit inequity in Boston using live MBTA data. Features include ghost bus detection, pain index scoring, RAG-based policy fact-checking against MBTA's own documents, a conversational transit agent ('Ask the T'), equity scorecards overlaid with Census demographics, and an auto-generated open letter to the MBTA Board. Built with Claude API, optional LangGraph/MCP paths, and RAG. Supports 7 languages including Haitian Creole and Arabic (RTL).
author: manisha002307735
